entries.title: Public scoreboard clock started
entries.summary: Published the immutable Federal Reserve credit-flow scoreboard and registered the scheduled prediction and first-print grading lanes.

entries.title: P0 attribution introduced
entries.summary: Published the first ten-company revenue-weighted DFRI estimate with 20,000-draw bands, tier shares, a public Assumption Registry, and company sensitivity rankings.

entries.title: Registry digest made cross-platform
entries.summary: Canonicalized attribution registry hashing and text assets so Windows and Linux cold clones publish byte-identical provenance metadata and site assets.

entries.title: Nowcast units and provenance made explicit
entries.summary: Clarified seasonally adjusted monthly-flow units, added plain-language forecast orientation and primary-source links, and made scoreboard sorting a JavaScript-only enhancement.

entries.title: P1 coverage expanded to 50 companies
entries.summary: Expanded the evidence-first consumer-company universe from 10 to 50, published the dated 31-company exclusion ledger, and retained methodology 1.0.0 results for direct comparison.

entries.title: Quarterly attribution refresh demonstrated
entries.summary: Recomputed the 2026-Q1 50-company attribution from six Board first-print monthly flows and point-in-time SEC filing facts; 35 denominators advanced through comparable 10-Q facts and 15 remained explicitly on their annual baseline.

entries.title: Carvana auto-finance classification corrected
entries.summary: Added Carvana's SEC-filed originated-auto-finance and ABS trust evidence, included CVNA in the covered-auto allocation, and published the derived Evidence Lift ranking under a non-breaking v2 company-feed schema.

entries.title: Graded feed status corrected
entries.summary: Corrected the scoreboard compatibility status so every graded row reports GRADED, matching grade_status; the feed schema now states and tests that invariant.

entries.title: First live grades published without softening
entries.summary: Published the first two live grades, prominently flagging that the revolving prediction missed direction and its 80% interval; added running live-only coverage and MAE comparisons without retraining or retuning the model.

entries.title: Numbers promoted; credit flow added
entries.summary: Compressed the heading scale so figures carry the hierarchy and added a server-rendered current-period flow view whose ribbon width represents estimated dollars and whose solid, dashed, and dotted styles expose evidence tiers without color dependence.

entries.title: Auto allocation moved to regulatory and filing evidence
entries.summary: Retired the NY Fed Household Debt and Credit source from the active auto-allocation assumption; reconciled FFIEC bank, NCUA credit-union, Federal Reserve Board G.19, and SEC Auto ABS evidence; separately versioned the resulting 50-company and headline-index restatement; and added computed source criticality with independent fallbacks and visible degraded-source bands.

entries.title: Company directory and ledger path clarified
entries.summary: Separated the homepage claims into an ordered reading path, promoted the immutable prediction ledger, grouped 38 indistinguishable baseline-only Evidence Lift rows behind a native disclosure, and added a complete alphabetical company directory without changing any estimate or feed.

entries.title: Prediction evidence moved beside the forecast
entries.summary: Used the wide homepage's prediction rail for the live ledger count and existing historical backtest figures, while preserving explicit live-versus-backtest labels, mobile reading order, and the separate live-grade calibration record.
